product_one_liner.value: Sprinto is an autonomous trust and GRC platform for startups, growing companies, and enterprises that automates compliance, risk management, vendor risk, AI governance, and audit readiness.

pricing_page.notes: The public page lists Foundation, Growth, and enterprise options, even though it does not show dollar prices.

employee_band.notes: The cited company profile reports 445 employees and a 201-500 company size.

eng_blog.notes: The readable index is a GRC/marketing blog; it does not show at least two engineer-authored posts about building Sprinto's architecture or infrastructure.

public_docs.notes: The public docs site contains multiple product areas, including getting started, integrations, audits, monitoring, compliance, risk, trust, and settings.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open job board lists roles, but none has an AI, ML, machine-learning, data-science, applied-scientist, research-scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer-vision title.

model_provider.notes: The reviewed AI posture, subprocessor list, docs, and blog materials describe AI use and integrations but do not identify a model provider used by Sprinto's product.

compliance_certs.notes: These five names are shown in Sprinto's homepage badge area and compliance claims.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round was the April 2024 Series B, outside the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Enterprise Sales Development Representative - US posting is available.

launched_6mo.notes: Sprinto announced July-August 2026 product updates, including Sprinto MCP on ChatGPT and Claude and a rebuilt AI engine; it also announced the Autonomous Trust Center launch on 2026-06-01.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Shourya Saha publicly said they joined Sprinto as Vice President of Customer Experience in June 2026.
